units: 1 map unit = 1 cell; eye .95 over a floor; door 1.85; step .245; body radius .2, height 1.12

components.doc: Open ground under the sky over whole cells.
Open floor under a roof `roof` high (cells); walls come from solid cells round it.
A ring of wall cells round a room; cut doors with `door`.
Solid cells: a wall, hedge, rock or fence `top` high.
A fence of solid cells (breakable where breakables.cfg says).
A floor tile over cells (a path, a rug, mud).
Cells' ground raised (or sunk) to `ground` (a step up needs <= .245).
A pool of lamp light on the cells round `at`.
A door in a wall cell (a grid door: 1 cell wide, 1.85 high).
An open doorway in a wall cell, no door.
A breakable glass pane across a cell.
A floor walked on and under (a loft, a landing, a catwalk), `thick` thick.
A solid block standing on the ground (a plinth, a dock, a stage), walked on.
A slope from z `from` up to `to` toward n/e/s/w (solid to the ground unless `thick`).
Stairs from `from` up to `to` toward n/e/s/w, treads `rise` high at most.
A free wall a to b; `openings` [{id, at, width, sill, head}] cut doors and windows.
A rail standing on z: stops bodies, not looks or shots.
Low solid cover a to b: stops bodies, looks and shots under its top.
A deck railed on the `open` sides (n, e, s, w); `gaps` [[side, from, to]].
A deck across a gap at `top`, railed along its long sides; walk under it.
A flat surface overhead (an overhang, a porch roof, an upper room's ceiling).
A room of any outline, a wall on each edge; `openings` [[edge, {at, width}]].
A roofed passage `width` cells wide along a path of cell centres (straight legs, n/s/e/w).
A box of furniture (a counter, a crate stack): stops bodies; not walked on.
A modelled prop (town_props.json names) standing at `at`.
A flat picture standing at `at` (a sign, a board).
A hand of `kind` (enemies.cfg) standing at `at`, on the floor at or under z.
A pickup lying at `at`.
An objective: a quest station used at `at`; `opens` door cells; `prop` a town_quest_<name>.
The level's exit (extraction) at `at`, open once `shutdown` is done.
A named place a player or bot can start a playtest from (and a versus spawn).
A name on the automap.
Says two or more objects overlap on purpose (validate stops calling it an error).

example.reason: the wall stands on the deck's edge on purpose
